1. Isocyanates can react with acids to produce carbon dioxide gas (CO2) and amines. This gas generation is not typically explosive or flammable.

2. More importantly, isocyanates can undergo violent polymerization reactions when catalyzed by acids. Isocyanates are known to polymerize rapidly under acidic conditions, which can be an exothermic (heat-generating) and potentially violent reaction.
